# Security Policy

## Scope

This repository contains **documentation only** (LaTeX source files and PDF output). There is no executable code, no user data handling, and no external dependencies that could introduce security vulnerabilities.

## Reporting Issues

If you identify any issue with the repository configuration (exposed credentials, misconfigured Actions, etc.), please:

1. **Do not** open a public issue
2. Contact the maintainer directly via GitHub ([@carlos-nader](https://github.com/carlos-nader))

For content-related issues (errors, typos, technical inaccuracies), please open a regular [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/carlos-nader/tms-dms-cms-usage-guide/issues).

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 0.x.x.x (pre-publication) | ✅ Current development |
| 1.x.x (future release) | 🔜 Planned |
